title: Hunted by the Flight Unit
summary: In the Jia Ma capital, Jia Xing Tian decides the imperial family will not stand against the Misty Cloud Sect for Xiao Yan, despite Hai Bodong's plea. Three Misty Cloud Sect elders lead the hunt in the Magical Beast Mountain Range, and their disciples shadow Xiao Yan without fighting him. When the disciples stop, Xiao Yan senses a Dou Huang arrive: Yun Yun, who draws Yun Shan's mark out of his body. Chased by a large flight unit, he finds his Purple Cloud Wings slower than true Dou Qi Wings, and Yao Lao spends his soul power to help him. Yun Lei catches him and boasts that he and Yun Sheng broke Xiao Zhan's limbs and that the sect has gone after the rest of the Xiao Clan. Xiao Yan sends the Heaven Swallowing Python ahead and uses the first change, the Green Lotus Change.
events: The imperial council chooses not to intervene; Hai Bodong objects.
Three sect elders sharpen the search; disciples tail but do not engage.
Yun Yun, a Dou Huang, arrives and draws out the mark.
The flight unit chases Xiao Yan; Yao Lao helps him until his soul power runs low.
Yun Lei taunts Xiao Yan about the attack on the Xiao Clan and his father.
Xiao Yan activates the Green Lotus Change.
introduced: Dou Qi Wings (true) vs Purple Cloud Wings
cultivation: The arriving aura 'It's a Dou Huang' (359.8), revealed as Yun Yun. EP68 recap: Xiao Yan 'has successfully broken through to the Three-Star Da Dou Shi level' (14).
